# Flow: routing review and report without an intake entry
Load when: decision row 3 (review routing), row 4 (report in a project the user names) or row 5 (report, project unknown) of SKILL.md

## Preconditions
1. Rows 3 and 5: P1 (routing preview) ran in this conversation; keep its `outcome` and `candidates[]`.
2. Row 3 only: step 0 passes (SKILL.md §2 item 2). Project owners and the `routing-owner` executive role cannot review. Rows 4 and 5: no role check (the server rejects a caller without access).
3. Review only an intake entry the web intake screen shows as `new` or `under_review`.
4. The review is not idempotent: a second approve or split creates new entries and a second decision ([intake-lifecycle](intake-lifecycle.md)).

## Steps
Review routing (row 3):
0. Role check (reuse §2 item 2 if it ran): `list_workspaces` (no `compact`) → row `id == workspaceId` → `access.canManage == true`. `access.canManage` false → say "Routing needs the workspace owner or an admin: ask them to choose." and STOP. Call fails, no row with `id == workspaceId`, or no `access` → give the error text, say "I could not confirm you can review routing in <workspaceId>." and STOP; do not ask the routing confirmation. "I am the owner" from the user is not proof.
1. Protocol known: `get_protocol`(protocolCode) (reuse the §3 read) → keep `workspaceId`, `intakeEntryId`, `operationalEntryIds`. `operationalEntryIds` not empty → STOP "Already routed: <operationalEntryIds>".
2. `action` is exactly `approve-primary`, `split-projects`, `reject` or `defer` (other values silently defer).
3. reject / defer: no project ids; reviewNotes = the owner's reason. approve-primary: `selectedProjectId` = the one project the owner named. split-projects: `selectedProjectIds` = 2+ distinct projects the owner named, primary first. A named project not in P1 `candidates[]` → re-run P1 with limitCount=10; still absent → take its `id` from `list_workspace_projects`(workspaceId) (same workspace, `archived` not true) and add "owner choice outside ranker top-10" to reviewNotes. approve-primary or split-projects without a project the owner named → STOP.
4. [C] Send the § Stop and ask question for the action word for word and fill every `<...>`. approve/split: type = the type in the user's words; none → your suggestion from the title plus "(suggested; reply with another type: bug, incident, improvement or request)"; never leave `<...>` or "?" in a slot. The user already said the web screen shows new or under review → drop that sentence. Send nothing else after the question, then STOP until "yes".
5. `review_workspace_routing`(workspaceId, intakeEntryId, action, selectedProjectId only for approve-primary, selectedProjectIds only for split, reviewNotes=<owner's reason>) [C] → keep `id`, `status`, `createdOperationalEntryIds`. reject / defer → step 8. Timeout or "Invalid workspace intake status transition" → never re-call. approve/split: entries may exist: `list_operational_entries`(projectId) per selected project → items with `sourceWorkspaceIntakeEntryId == intakeEntryId`, or `get_protocol_lineage`; report them. reject/defer: nothing was created except a decision record; report that.
6. `createdOperationalEntryIds[i]` is in the i-th selected project: `get_operational_entry`(projectId, entryId) → keep `type` (`request`) and `technicalContext` (may be null).
7. `update_operational_entry`(projectId, entryId, technicalContext = (old ? old + " | " : "") + "Routing <id>: <reviewNotes>") [C]; add `type` only when the type confirmed in step 4 differs from the entry's current `type` (step 6); otherwise omit `type`.
8. Verify (§ Verify): `status` `approved` with one id per project (or `rejected`/`deferred`, none); each entry `sourceWorkspaceIntakeEntryId == intakeEntryId`, `type` and `technicalContext` as sent; protocol → `get_protocol_lineage` lists them.

Report without an intake entry (rows 4 and 5):
9. Row 4: the user named the project → projectId via `lpm-start` §3; no role check. Row 5: P1 with title and description; the user names one project in this conversation → keep the quote; no explicit pick → STOP.
10. `list_operational_entries`(projectId, status="open") → `items[].title`; cursor=`nextCursor` while `hasMore`. Same problem found → ask "same problem" (§ Stop and ask). One more occurrence → `get_operational_entry`(projectId, id) → `occurrenceCount` n → `update_operational_entry`(projectId, id, occurrenceCount=n+1) [C] → Verify: `occurrenceCount == n+1`; stop here. New entry → step 11.
11. [C] Ask the report confirmation (§ Stop and ask); continue only on "yes".
12. `create_operational_entry`(projectId, type, title, description) [C] → keep `id`. Add perceivedSeverity / impactScore only if the user stated them; otherwise omit them (priority `low`) and say so. Timeout → list first.
13. Verify: `get_operational_entry`(projectId, id) → `curationState == "new"`, `title` as sent.

## Stop and ask
Ask in the user's language: translate the template, keep ids, enum values and the quoted reason verbatim; yes/no → sim/não in PT-BR.

| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| routing approve-primary / split-projects (step 4) | the text block below |
| routing reject / defer (step 4) | "Mark intake <intakeEntryId> as <rejected\|deferred>, notes '<reason>'? No project entry is created. No MCP undo. (yes/no)" |
| same problem (step 10) | "Same as '<title>' (<id>)? Add one occurrence there (update_operational_entry occurrenceCount=<n+1>) or register a new entry?" |
| report (step 11) | "Create <type> entry '<title>' in <projectName>, as you chose ('<quote>')? (yes/no)" |

Routing approve-primary / split-projects (one Preview line per P1 candidate; split: `selectedProjectIds=[<id>, <id>]` in place of `selectedProjectId`):
```text
Preview <outcome>: <projectName (id)> — score <score> — matchedTerms <terms> — completeness <routingProfileCompleteness>. A keyword match is not proven ownership.
Is it new or under review in the web screen?
Route intake <intakeEntryId> (<action>) with review_workspace_routing(workspaceId=<id>, intakeEntryId=<id>, action=<action>, selectedProjectId=<id>, reviewNotes='<reason>') to <projectName (id)>? It creates one entry per project (type request); then I set type <type> and copy the reason into technicalContext. No undo. (yes/no)
```

## Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| `review_workspace_routing` | `get_operational_entry`, `get_protocol_lineage` | `sourceWorkspaceIntakeEntryId == intakeEntryId`; lineage lists the ids |
| `update_operational_entry`, `create_operational_entry` | `get_operational_entry` | `type`, `technicalContext`, `occurrenceCount`, `title` as sent |

A read-back field that differs from what you sent (type, technicalContext) is a failed verify: name the field, sent vs read, under Pending; never write "verified" or "all pass".

## Report fields
Scope (workspace, intakeEntryId or protocolCode, project ids), decision `id` + `action`, created entry ids with project, owner's reason (quoted), Pending, Next.
After approve/split: Pending = curation of each created entry (`curationState` `new`) by its project owner, product owner or delivery lead; the requester's `lastPublicStatus` is unchanged until a reply is recorded (SKILL.md row 11). Next = triage <entryId> `new` → `under_review` → `classified` (SKILL.md row 6).
